policy_note: Source registry for market-data provenance. Automation is enabled only where access is stable and permitted; blocked sources remain assisted/manual. Source roles are kept separate so listing asking prices are not mixed with official/consultancy market benchmarks.

sources.label: Batdongsan.com.vn
sources.primary_use: Project-level asking range, 1Y listing trend, popular area; listing counts/views ancillary only.

sources.label: CBRE Vietnam
sources.primary_use: Supply, sales/absorption and benchmark market research.

sources.label: Savills Vietnam
sources.primary_use: Supply, absorption, pricing and segment benchmark research.

sources.label: JLL Vietnam
sources.primary_use: Market supply, demand and benchmark research.

sources.label: Cushman & Wakefield Vietnam
sources.primary_use: Market supply, demand, pricing and outlook research.

sources.label: OneHousing
sources.primary_use: Monthly category modal/popular asking price or historical distributor starting price, source-specific and never merged into Batdongsan price trends.

sources.label: Rever
sources.primary_use: Dated single-listing asking price or archived advertised launch starting price. Not project average.
